zh: 优化左下角「扫码使用」按钮交互：增加 320ms 悬停防抖过滤与 260ms 移出延时收起，杜绝光标滑过误触，并支持点击直接 Toggle 开关。
对话文件右侧抽屉预览全面升级：.md 文件优先显示富文本渲染，.html 文件优先显示网页沙箱效果，并支持一键切换源码模式与版本对比查看（Diff）。
脚本与代码文件预览新增多语言语法高亮与行号显示，支持 Python、JavaScript、HTML、CSS、SQL、JSON、Bash 等多种常见语言。
优化会话列表交互，对三方桌面 Agent 与外部频道对话重命名尝试增加友好提示引导。
en: Refined sidebar scan-to-use button with 320ms hover debounce and 260ms auto-dismiss delay to eliminate accidental triggers, plus click-to-toggle support.
Upgraded right-side chat file preview: Markdown files prioritize rich rendered output, HTML files prioritize sandboxed web preview, with instant switching to source code and diff views.
Added automatic multi-language syntax highlighting and line numbers for code previews including Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, JSON, and Bash.
Enhanced conversation list interaction with helpful guidance when attempting to rename third-party agent or channel chats.
